name: Free Online ZIP Encrypt & Decrypt Tool - ATools
description: Free online standard ZIP encrypt & decrypt tool: Locally package files into password-protected standard ZIP archives (WinZip AES-256 & ZipCrypto), with decryption & extraction support.
seoDescription: Free online standard ZIP encryption and decryption tool. Locally package and encrypt files into standard password-protected .zip archives in your browser. Supports industry-standard WinZip AES-256 and legacy ZipCrypto encryption, fully compatible with 7-Zip, WinRAR, macOS Archive Utility, and Windows native unzip. Also supports decrypting password-protected ZIP archives and extracting files. Pure client-side processing without uploading files.
